criteria.text: States that the lock-up expires on 13 December 2026 (180 days after the 16 June 2026 Prospectus date).
Identifies the undisclosed $4,000,000 interest-free loan to director Aoife Abernethy that must be described in the Prospectus Related Party Transactions section.
Identifies that the comfort letter cut-off of 4 June 2026 is 12 days before the 16 June 2026 pricing date, outside the 3-business-day requirement in Clause 7(b), so a bring-down letter is needed.
Gives the lock-up as a duration (180 days) and a date (13 December 2026), with days remaining from 27 May 2026 (200 days).
Notes that 13 December 2026 is a Sunday and identifies the next Business Day, 14 December 2026, as the first trading opportunity.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
